g.text: Rust engine: process trust-control-studio (checklist rust-logic-migration.md: V0 foundation, V1 Identify, V2 Tune, V3 Validate, V4 Apply/Restore/Keep, V5 setup; serves the panel from V6)
Existing runtime services
Shared truST theme and controls
immediate checkbox dropdowns, compact editors, response charts
Identify
plant inputs, measured outputs, method
Identify plant / Open recording / Limits
model review: Identify plant / Reset study / Tune tab
selected readings + response before identification
model equation + applied input + measured/model response
Tune
actual controller instance or declared PID group
method, Requirements, conditional Channels
manual/pinned settings + predicted response
Validate
mandatory results + measured response
explicit Apply / Restore previous settings
Loop monitor (controlStudio/monitor)
the engine decides availability, staleness, quality, mode
and the target label from one coherent scan, read on a background thread
the call answers at once with the last sample held; the page keeps a bounded history of the samples it is given
Scoped host-state projection
operation, binding and recovery state
page navigation does not start work
Contextual manual tools
project experiments, recorded fits, model analysis
selected through existing methods
shared model-comparison evidence and saved fit controls
Loop setup form
structure: PID, cascade, feedforward, Smith predictor, gain schedule, PID group, ON/OFF,
state feedback, own P, PI or PID, other law
(coefficients searched), or identify only
structures and choices come from setupDiscover; each draft is posted as typed;
the engine answers any refusal under its field
Panel message boundary
project, loop revision and editor session
deduplicated requests and current-scope checks
no session or study store of its own
Engine panel route (engine/enginePanelRoute.ts)
starts one trust-control-studio serve per window
every loop goes to the engine in the order the page made the requests (study inputs first),
including Open recording… and Open model…, and the Recorded-data fit (identify manualEdit, manualQualify, manualFit)
the engine's answers, updates and opened study go to the page;
a loop the engine refuses shows its refusal and next action, and nothing else opens; presentation and wiring only
Setup and project routes (loopSetup/setupEngine.ts, loopSetupPanel.ts,
threePageBindingRoute.ts, engine/engineProjectLoops.ts)
send setupDiscover, setupSave and projectLoops with the drafts as typed;
open the engine's open request; the engine decides every choice, refusal and loop file
Analysis route (engine/routes/analyzeRoute.ts)
every loop's Tune analysis goes to controlStudio/analyze;
quick answers and operations; the engine records the shown analysis
and names the answers a change made stale; a refused loop shows its refusal; no calculation of its own
Runtime lifecycle and endpoint (runtimeLifecycle.ts, runtimeStartAction.ts,
engine/engineConnection.ts)
exact simulator/project binding; start, cancellation and close ownership
passes the engine the endpoint, the token and the selected runtime id
TypeScript: presentation and wiring only (V7.17)
the page shows the engine's answers: stage availability, Apply/Restore/Keep offers and confirmation, method offers,
experiment limits and duration words, manual setting rows, model words, plant summary, refusals under their fields,
outcome and status sentences, answer kinds, signal roles and plot signals (liveSides, plotSignals)
forwarding, held identities, sequencing, view state and VS Code dialogs stay here; no second copy of an engine rule
the TypeScript logic modules are gone: loop checks, identification, controller design and tuning, commissioning and apply,
numerics, setup generators and the parked features (V7); the page keeps no lock, check or default of its own

g.text: trust-control (pure, no I/O)
loop contract, signal reads (E3), recordings and their evidence (E4),
experiment plans and checks (E5), study container and sections,
study inputs merge and channel selection (A8.1);
identification rules: policy, campaign baseline and hold, review,
model selection (N3.3), recorded limits (B3.4), provisional model;
tuning rules: requirements, formulas, Automatic recommendation,
design to requirements, candidates and pins, Control.PID prediction,
margins and robustness; finite search rules (C5); study Tune section (A8.4);
analysis (B9.9): frequency, measured response, feedback and Nyquist, root locus,
Routh, pole-zero, lead/lag, initial state, state structure, relative gain;
opened recordings: archive reading, channel catalogue, independent pairs;
validation rules: plan, scenarios, campaign, run assessment (N8),
model check, plant decision, isolated-run records; Validate section;
commissioning rules (B6, A6, C0, C1): starting point, Auto-entry allowance,
transfer records and checks (E6), parameter transactions (E7), initialization,
observation, the one Restore from the checkpoint, Keep's edits; Apply section;
setup rules (B1): compiled catalog, form model (defaults, limits, words), generators, save;
loop monitor and target label (B2, A2.4, B9.2); export of results (B10.5);
failures with next actions (A11); json: every decode with normalized numbers

g.data-qualified-name: Rust engine. process trust-control-studio .checklist rust-logic-migration.md. V0 foundation. V1 Identify. V2 Tune. V3 Validate. V4 Apply.Restore.Keep. V5 setup. serves the panel from V6..rust_commands
g.text: trust-control-studio (engine crate and program)
serve: JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout, Content-Length frames
command line (§0.1b): open, identify, tune, validate, apply, restore, keep, setup, cancel;
token never an argument; apply/restore/keep: review, then --review <identity>
methods (§0.1a): controlStudio/open | status | cancel | page | inputs | run | identify | tune | preview |
validate | apply | restore | keep | setupDiscover | setupStep | setupSave | projectLoops | analyze | parameters | export | monitor |
plantMonitor | simulatorStart | simulatorStartResult | chartExport
analyze: the Tune page's tools for every loop, quick or as operations;
identify importRecording / importModel / openRecording, Recorded-data fit (manualEdit, manualQualify, manualFit), reset;
inputs: the study inputs merge and channel selection (A8.1); run: Identify, Tune, Validate in order, stops at Apply (B8);
monitor: the live sample and target label, read on a background thread (B2, B9.2);
export: the loop's results as JSON or CSV text, for the engineer to save (B10.5)
Identify workflow: campaign driver, reconciliation, recovery
Tune: Automatic, SIMC, AMIGO, relay rule, manual settings, state-space;
the finite search (C5) for a search law, one isolated run per trial;
designs from the study model, never writes to the controller;
the relay rule reads its recording; preview stores nothing
Validate: live model check (provisional model), then isolated
actual-ST runs of current and candidate per scenario (E8.4), journaled
Apply: starting point wait, Manual staging, parameters, Auto entry, observed
target change; a failure after the first write runs the one Restore
Identify: enters and returns the mode its method needs (A6.2)
long operations: operationId at once, controlStudio/update

g.data-qualified-name: Rust engine. process trust-control-studio .checklist rust-logic-migration.md. V0 foundation. V1 Identify. V2 Tune. V3 Validate. V4 Apply.Restore.Keep. V5 setup. serves the panel from V6..rust_campaign
g.text: Identification campaign (workflow/identify_campaign.rs;
rules in trust-control identification/campaign.rs and settle.rs)
1. the plant input range and the review's approval block (B3.4 step 1)
2. steady baseline (B3.4 step 2): the longer of 5 % of the maximum duration and, when declared, 10 % of the expected settling time, capped at 30 min, never under 20 samples;
waits at most the longest of 5 minutes, 20 % of the maximum duration and two baseline windows
3. the step at the next execution of the loop's task (A3.5)
4. hold until settled (B3.4 step 4)
5. restoration: the runtime restores the plant input or setpoint and confirms it (A7); Identify does not wait for the process to return (B3.4 step 5)

g.data-qualified-name: Rust engine. process trust-control-studio .checklist rust-logic-migration.md. V0 foundation. V1 Identify. V2 Tune. V3 Validate. V4 Apply.Restore.Keep. V5 setup. serves the panel from V6..rust_observation
g.text: Apply observation (workflow/apply_observation.rs;
rule in trust-control commissioning/observation.rs)
the recording starts before the validated target change, and is followed in process time
every sample of each measured output is checked against its permitted range
a departure restores the previous settings at once (B6.3, B6.7)

g.data-qualified-name: Rust engine. process trust-control-studio .checklist rust-logic-migration.md. V0 foundation. V1 Identify. V2 Tune. V3 Validate. V4 Apply.Restore.Keep. V5 setup. serves the panel from V6..rust_validation
g.text: Validation (trust-control validation/; workflow/validate_model_check.rs)
independent model check (B5.2): a new live campaign with a different excitation; the frozen model's
free-running prediction compared with the recorded output over the whole response and its final 10 %;
a passing check qualifies the model; a failing check blocks Apply
verification campaign: mandatory scenarios, initial states and constraints; missing scenarios remain Inconclusive
selected-model prediction: Control.PID calculated, switching, state-feedback, project laws and PID groups run as ST on the model
isolated actual-ST runs (B5.3): the configured simulated plant when it drives the loop's signals, otherwise the qualified model;
the result names each case's plant

g.data-qualified-name: Rust engine. process trust-control-studio .checklist rust-logic-migration.md. V0 foundation. V1 Identify. V2 Tune. V3 Validate. V4 Apply.Restore.Keep. V5 setup. serves the panel from V6..rust_tuning
g.text: Controller adapters and tuning (trust-control tuning/, tuning/structures.rs)
existing Control.PID / declared project / state controllers
cascade: inner first, outer through the closed inner loop
feedforward: PI on the output path, K_ff and lead/lag from both paths
Smith predictor: model K, T, θ from the model; PI on the delay-free model
decoupler: D = K⁻¹·diag(K), each PI through it
Automatic: response chosen by its predicted requirements
automatic test criteria (tuning/automatic_criteria.rs): model timescale, recording noise and operating limits;
explicit values kept; generated values frozen before validation
explicit choices, parameter mapping and pins
finite Riccati stages with explicit fixed runtime policy

control-loops/<name>.json, never overwritten
setupSave writes each new loop definition; projectLoops answers each folder's files
Native isolated execution (control.simulation.run.*)
actual selected ST controller
configured plant, or the study's selected model as simulation_override (C5, B5.3)
Runtime parameter/transfer transactions
complete declared target binding
observed acknowledgement and recovery identities
Running ST controller and plant
primary journey: Control.PID
existing native simulated-plant adapters
Runtime experiment executor
control/experiment_handlers/executor.rs
runs at the loop task's executions; observes each
scan once; writes apply at the next task boundary
Engineer, script or CI
trust-lsp inline values
(no Control Studio part)
trust-lsp command (spec 14 §7.8)
headless project commands: hmiBindings (setup catalog),
controlKeepParameters, hmiEquipment (Keep's edits)
Identification stops on its model for review.
Tabs only navigate; Tune starts on request and stops at its candidate.
Validate starts the independent model check and controller campaign.
Reset moves the working study to history and starts a new one.
Live selected-signal observation continues after Reset/reopen.
The chart grows from current plant readings during acquisition.
Model comparisons retain the matching experiment inputs.
Automatic continuation (run) never dispatches Apply.
All pages display the same host-owned study.
Every loop runs in trust-control-studio, which answers each stage; a loop the
engine refuses shows its refusal and next action. No TypeScript session or
study store remains (V7.17).
Closing the panel detaches this client only. A running identification
experiment and its recording stay with the runtime; the operation journal
stays in the user's local state folder (A8.3), and reopening reattaches and
completes the campaign.
A client that still owns its experiment aborts it only on an explicit
Cancel or after a failure, through the restoration path.
Closing during an Apply's observation detaches it the same way: the runtime
keeps recording the response, and reopening reattaches at once, assesses it
and reports the Apply's journalled transfers with the target change.
An Apply interrupted before its observation began is recovered by reviewed
recovery: the runtime recording is stopped, its samples are kept in the
checkpoint and the runtime buffer is released.
Removed from Control Studio: Manual Record, model-based validation
(validation.ts), automatic tune (automaticTune.ts), and the automatic
matched anti-windup comparison (no panel entry point).
Protocol: docs/specs/control-studio-runtime-protocol.md;
numerics: docs/specs/control-studio-numerics.md (replacing the satellite specs).
A declared coherent multivariable adapter uses its complete binding.
Separate PID instances are never updated by an invented sequential group write.
Not a session and not a store: the engine answers every served method,
and the page renders its answers (AGENTS.md: all logic is in Rust).
scripts/list_control_studio_files.py lists what the product reaches.
